na_policy.reason: N_A performance is permitted only for objectives that are purely structural/governance correctness checks with no semantically meaningful runtime budget at that objective boundary. It cannot be used to waive performance for runtime, materialization, quality/depth, or E2E objectives.

F04-O2.reason: Typed-context rejection happens on an executable runtime boundary and requires measured fail-closed cost on the final candidate.

F04-O3.reason: Typed-context type/version rejection is an executable runtime boundary and requires measured fail-closed cost on the final candidate.

F04-O4.reason: Typed-context contamination rejection is an executable runtime boundary and requires measured fail-closed cost on the final candidate.

F06-O2.reason: UI material-requirement rejection has a measurable validator/materialization budget and must not be waived.

F06-O3.reason: UI content/design-intent rejection has a measurable validator/materialization budget and must not be waived.

F06-O4.reason: Content/layout contradiction handling is part of materialization and requires a final-candidate performance measurement.

F08-O1.reason: The same deterministic QDP path is already budget-bound by frozen evidence; reuse is cross-binding, not an additional independent case.

F08-O2.reason: The same deterministic QDP path is already budget-bound by frozen evidence; reuse is cross-binding, not an additional independent case.

F08-O3.reason: The shallow-answer adversarial path is model/materialization dependent and needs timing on the final candidate.

F08-O4.reason: Conflict/ambiguity reasoning is model dependent and needs timing on the final candidate.

F10-O4.reason: Cross-run replay/live contamination protection is an E2E objective with measurable execution cost.

effective_status_policy.COVERED: All applicable dimensions must be COVERED; N_A is allowed only by na_policy.
effective_status_policy.PARTIAL: At least one applicable dimension is COVERED/PARTIAL but the objective is not fully evidenced.
effective_status_policy.NOT_DEMONSTRATED: Material frozen evidence is insufficient; one or more required dimensions remain PENDING.
effective_status_policy.NEW_CASE_REQUIRED: Historical evidence is intentionally insufficient because a new/unseen holdout is required.

family_pass_policy: All five distinct objectives must effectively be COVERED and at least one of the five must be satisfied by a genuine unseen holdout in the final certification run.
system_pass_policy: All families PASS, all transversal hard gates PASS, mutation sensitivity PASS, metamorphic/differential relations PASS, and no critical deterministic/quality/depth failure exists. Aggregate percentages never override a hard failure.

performance_policy.deterministic: Use hard budgets and descriptive p50/p95 where repeated timings exist.
performance_policy.stochastic_model_dependent: Use repeated runs and clustered/hierarchical analysis only when inferential interpretation is needed; correlated runs are not independent cases.
performance_policy.correctness_precedence: Performance cannot compensate a correctness, provenance, quality or depth failure.
